seed_why: PUBLIC: keys the target pool and the viewers' own streams only; the full sha of thought-master's leaf commit, not chosen
secret_why: 32 bytes of os.urandom made at run time (harness.py secret-new), kept outside the repo until the results commit reveals it; keys EVERY harness-side draw (targets, decoys, salt, shuffle, judge ties); no viewer is handed it
targets: 200 distinct, drawn without replacement across the run
falsifier_1: F1_null: the null viewer (policy 0) over trials 0..199 must be inside chance (hits < band_hits_lt, one-sided binomial 95%); outside = the harness LEAKS
falsifier_2: F2_salt_planted: the SaltMutantViewer handed the salt before it describes must be OUTSIDE chance; inside = the harness cannot see a planted leak
falsifier_3: any later viewer: its held-out (trials 100..199, n = 100) hit rate must beat chance at p < 0.01, whatever its train curve
falsifier_4: F4: the seed-reader viewer (re-derives targets from the public seed) must be inside chance on this harness AND outside it on the public-keyed (round-1) harness
falsifier_5: F5: the position-0 judge (a judge-side channel) must be inside chance on this harness AND outside it with the candidate shuffle removed
verdict_rule: proved iff every arm reads as required (F1, F4 real, F5 real inside; F2, F4 public-keyed, F5 shuffle-removed outside); else disproved
